name: Decatur Lateral (Midcoast to Calpine Decatur and Morgan Energy Centers)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Decatur Lateral; Midcoast to Calpine Decatur and Morgan Energy Centers

researcher_notes: EIA natural gas pipeline projects release of August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 235: Decatur Power Lateral, operator MidCoast Pipeline Co, a completed lateral in Alabama, in service June 2002, 50 miles of 30 inch pipe, 160 MMcf/d additional capacity, cost 23 million dollars, intrastate under state authority. A Natural Gas Intelligence article from 2000 (Midcoast to Supply Calpine's Plants) says Midcoast Energy Resources agreed to move up to 276 MMcf/d to the 700 MW Decatur Energy Center and the 660 MW Morgan Energy Center near Decatur, Alabama, with a 52 mile pipeline to be built next to its existing Midcoast Interstate Transmission system. Planned 52 miles versus as-built 50 miles; the as-built figure from EIA is staged. The two sources are independent (a trade press report and a government dataset). No GEM row exists: P7814 is a different, proposed Transcontinental project, and no other Alabama row matches. Intrastate line, so FERC filings are not expected; state regulator document not checked. Start and end points are only the region; exact endpoints not found, so no start location. Owner left blank: the 2000 operator was Midcoast Energy Resources Inc, and the line later passed through American Midstream and Midcoast Energy Partners, so the current owner needs a separate check. The gazetteer has Midcoast Energy LLC, but it is not confirmed to be the same entity. No route found; RouteType unavailable. Length is well over 25 km, so the length rule is met. Medium tier because the owner and endpoints are unresolved.
